submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 at 30 GeV threshold achieves the highest signal efficiency of 92.472% across all tested configurations. This represents a substantial improvement over Algorithm-L2 (best: 84.626% at 40 GeV) and Algorithm-L3 (best: 74.130% at 30 GeV). The 30 GeV threshold is well within the allowed range of 20-60 GeV and is lower than the baseline threshold of 35 GeV, which helps maximize signal acceptance while maintaining the allocated trigger rate of 8 kHz. All three algorithms are confirmed to be hardware-deployable in the Level-1 trigger system, so the choice is purely optimization-driven. Algorithm-L1 at 30 GeV delivers approximately 7.8 percentage points higher efficiency than the next-best option, making it the clear choice for maximizing physics reach.
